awarded.title: Voting power lost when a voted-for gauge is removed (require gauge_type>=0 blocks vote-withdrawal from removed gauges)
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning): I READ the exact lines — flagged the comment-vs-require contradiction at L387/L402 in coverage notes but did NOT raise it as a finding. The require(gauge_type>=0,'Gauge not added') prevents users from setting weight 0 on a removed gauge, so their vote_user_power stays consumed forever.

awarded.title: change_gauge_weight can permanently DoS a gauge (slope underflow in _get_weight/_get_sum)
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning): pt.slope -= d_slope can underflow when weight was manually reduced; I did not flag the slope-underflow path (only the bias path). Downstream DoSes claim + gauge withdraw via update_market.

awarded.title: remove_gauge always reverts when gauge has non-zero weight (gauge_types_ erased before _remove_gauge_weight -> gauge_type -1 underflow)
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: my N-01 named the identical root cause (remove_gauge zeroes gauge_types_ BEFORE _remove_gauge_weight reads gauge_types_[_gauge]-1 = -1) and the identical fix (move the zeroing AFTER _remove_gauge_weight). I described the consequence as type -1 corruption/weight-not-removed; the awarded impact is the resulting arithmetic underflow revert — same bug, same line, same mitigation.

awarded.title: Improper adjustment of LendingLedger config: setRewards/setBlockTimeParameters retroactively apply to non-updated markets

awarded.title: Truncation exploitation of sync_ledger (rounding-down rewardDebt -> free rewards via repeated tiny transfers)
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning): the rewardDebt += (delta*accPerShare)/1e18 rounds down; repeated tiny syncs accumulate untracked reward -> free claim. I noted the scaling but did not derive the truncation exploit.

awarded.title: Improper parallel time system: block-number->time estimation feeds gauge_relative_weight, future timestamp yields 0 -> lost epoch rewards
awarded.label: SAME_AREA
awarded.note: SAME_AREA: my N-04 named the same mechanism — update_market's epochTime (from block.number deltas) is mis-fed to gauge_relative_weight_write, misattributing/zeroing epoch weight. Awarded core = the parallel-time-system drift; I flagged the epochTime-in-loop variant of it.
